data_description.resource: Address of the BL-NET, e.g. http://192.168.1.10
data_description.password: Password of the "Expert" user of the web interface. Leave empty if none is set.
data_description.use_web: Read names and values from the web interface. Needed for switching outputs.
data_description.use_ta: Read values over the BL-NET's direct TCP connection. Needed for speed, power and energy.
data_description.web_port: Port of the web interface, usually 80
data_description.ta_port: Port of the direct connection, usually 40000
data_description.can_node: CAN node of the controller. Leave empty to keep the node selected on the BL-NET.
